consequence.statement: The `max_transfer_retries` setting will be ignored and no longer honored during chunk transfer operations when ingesters shut down during rolling restarts, requiring reliance on the Write Ahead Log (WAL) instead.

assertion.statement: The ingester configuration setting `max_transfer_retries` and its corresponding CLI flag `-ingester.max-transfer-retries` are removed in Loki 3.0.0 in favor of the Write Ahead Log (WAL).
